name: Ground-plum
desc: Ground-plum (Astragalus crassicarpus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Astragalus crassicarpus, known as ground plum or buffalo plum, is a perennial species of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae, native to North America. It was described in 1813.
